proposal.reason: Main change is symmetric-memory AllGather policy: new automatic CE-vs-kernel selection based on rank/graph/in-place thresholds and all-rank eligibility checks. Also requires copy-engine review because CE execution was substantively refactored (partition assignment, local/remote stream-group batch submission, memcpy-batch gating, and SM89/OKI-related CE/P2P DMA path conditions).
